people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.
translations.bsb: “Throw it on the ground,” said the LORD. So Moses threw it on the ground, and it became a snake, and he ran from it.
